description: This source file defines the internal class 'CopierGenerator' in the Orleans.CodeGenerator namespace. It contains methods for generating deep and shallow copy classes for serializable types, including handling complex base types, serialization hooks, and different copy strategies (shallow, deep, activator-based). It is part of the Orleans code generation system, specifically responsible for creating copier classes used for object cloning during serialization.

classes.name: CopierGenerator
classes.description: A class responsible for generating copier classes that implement deep and shallow copying of serializable types, handling complex scenarios like base types, serialization hooks, and various copy strategies.

classes.name: CopierGenerator.BaseCopierFieldDescription
classes.description: Represents a description for the base type copier field, indicating whether it is injected or concrete.

classes.name: CopierGenerator.CopierFieldDescription
classes.description: Represents a copier field with an underlying type, used internally by the CopierGenerator to manage copier fields for serializable members.

methods.name: GenerateCopier
methods.description: Generates a copier class declaration for a given serializable type, handling shallow copies, deep copies, exception types, and inheritance.

methods.name: GetFieldDeclarations
methods.description: Creates syntax nodes for declaring fields based on the provided field descriptions.

methods.name: GenerateConstructor
methods.description: Creates a constructor for the generated copier class, initializing fields based on parameters and injection.

methods.name: GetFieldDescriptions
methods.description: Gathers descriptions of fields required for copying, including base type, activator, copier fields, and serialization hooks.

methods.name: GetBaseTypeField
methods.description: Determines the description for the base type copier field, considering attributes and generics.

methods.name: GetCopierFieldDescriptions
methods.description: Enumerates and determines copier fields for the members of a serializable type.

methods.name: GenerateMemberwiseDeepCopyMethod
methods.description: Creates a method that performs a member-wise deep copy of an object of the serializable type.

methods.name: GenerateBaseCopierDeepCopyMethod
methods.description: Creates a method that performs deep copying involving the base type copier, if applicable.

methods.name: GenerateMemberwiseCopy
methods.description: Adds statements to perform copying of individual members from source to destination, using appropriate copiers.

methods.name: GenerateMemberCopy
methods.description: Generates an expression to copy a single member, using the available copiers or defaulting to input value.

methods.name: AddSerializationCallbacks
methods.description: Adds callback invocations for serialization hooks during the copying process.
